title: A compass alone can do everything ruler-and-compass can
body: The Mohr-Mascheroni theorem says every point constructible with ruler and compass is constructible with compass alone; the ruler's lines are recoverable from circles. Mohr published it in 1672 and was forgotten; Mascheroni re-proved it in 1797 and kept the fame. Tools in geometry constrain methods far less than they appear to.
